errors.text_span: с етикети на всеки две години
errors.evidence: The description states that the x-axis has labels every two years, but the figure shows labels for every single year from 2006 to 2019.

errors.text_span: светлосива на цвят с пунктирен стил
errors.evidence: The description claims the line is light grey and dotted/dashed, but the figure shows a solid, dark grey line.

errors.text_span: и кръгче като маркер във всяка отбелязана точка
errors.evidence: The description states that the line has circle markers at each data point, but there are no markers on the line in the figure.

errors.text_span: Започвайки от 2006 г. с приблизително 2,2% инфлация
errors.evidence: The starting value in 2006 is closer to 2.4%.

errors.text_span: От 2010 до 2013 г. има постепенно увеличение до около 2,1%
errors.evidence: This misrepresents the trend between 2010 and 2013. The value stays flat from 2010 to 2011 (at ~1.8%), rises to a peak of ~2.6% in 2012, and then drops back to ~1.8% in 2013. It is not a gradual increase to 2.1%.
The value in 2014 is significantly lower, at approximately 0.2%.

errors.text_span: по-рязък спад до около -0,1% през 2015 г.
errors.evidence: The value in 2015 is the minimum on the chart, at approximately -0.5%, not -0.1%.
The value in 2017 is closer to 1.4%.

errors.text_span: след което стойностите се покачват до около 1,6% през 2018
errors.evidence: The description says the value rises to ~1.6% in 2017 and then rises again to ~1.6% in 2018, which is confusing and inaccurate. The value in 2018 is higher, around 1.7%.
The final value in 2019 is approximately 1.6%, not 1.1%.
